name: new-agenda

scripts.test: node --input-type=module -e "import { runAllTests } from './tests/test-suite.js'; runAllTests().then(r => { const f = r.filter(x => !x.passed); console.log('Passed: ' + r.filter(x => x.passed).length + ' / ' + r.length); if (f.length > 0) { console.error('Failed:', f); process.exit(1); } });"
